shell.demo: Demo church. Data here is fictional and can be reset at any time.
shell.readOnly: Your subscription needs attention. Ecclesia is read-only until payment is updated.

auth.signInLead: Use the email and password for your church account.
auth.signUpLead: You can set up your church on the next screen.
auth.name: Full name
auth.invalidCredentials: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
auth.signUpFailed: We couldn't create that account. The email may already be registered.
auth.verse: Let all things be done decently and in order.
auth.signInUnavailable: We couldn't sign you in right now. Check that the app and database are running, then try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your church
onboarding.lead: This creates your church workspace with default roles, attendance categories and service times. You can change all of them later.
onboarding.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Used in links.

locked.title: This church's subscription has ended
locked.lead: Your data is safe. Reactivate the subscription to sign back in, or contact your church administrator.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noChange: No earlier month to compare with
dashboard.serving: {count, plural, one {# serving in a team} other {# serving in teams}}
dashboard.trendLead: Average headcount per service, split by category. Shaded bands mark the church seasons.
dashboard.noData: No attendance has been captured yet. Capture your first service to see trends here.

people.title: People
people.lead: Everyone connected to the church, from first-time visitors to leaders.
people.count: {count, plural, =0 {No people} one {# person} other {# people}}
people.empty: No one matches that search. Try a different name or clear the filters.
people.emptyDirectory: The directory is empty. Add the first person to get started.

teams.title: Teams
teams.lead: Departments, the positions in them, and who holds each one today.
teams.empty: No teams yet. Teams and positions appear here once they are created.
teams.deleteLead: The team and its positions will be removed. This can’t be undone.
teams.leadershipHint: People here can manage this team if their role allows it.
teams.endLead: They stay in the team’s history.
teams.noPositions: No positions yet. Add the first one.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.lead: Capture headcounts per service and category. Counts can be corrected later and every change is logged.
attendance.captureLead: Count each section and save. Saving again replaces the earlier counts.
attendance.empty: No services yet. Start the first one above.

errors.invalidPhone: Enter a phone number with digits only, for example +27821234567.
errors.futureDate: This date can't be in the future.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.slugTaken: That short name is already in use. Try another.

subscription.readOnly: Ecclesia is read-only until the subscription is updated.

person.invalidStatusTransition: That status change isn't allowed. Move people one step at a time along their growth path.

errors.invalidTimeZone: Choose a time zone from the list.
errors.duplicatePermission: Each permission can only be set once.
errors.invalidScope: That access level isn’t available for this permission.

assignment.alreadyHeld: This person already holds this position.
assignment.endBeforeStart: The last day can’t be before the start date.

members.lastAdmin: At least one person must be able to manage members. Give someone else that access first.
members.alreadyMember: That person is already a member of this church.
members.alreadyInvited: There’s already an open invitation for that email. Revoke it first to send a new one.
members.selfRole: You can’t change your own role. Ask another administrator.

roles.inUse: This role is still assigned to members. Move them to another role first.

teams.hasHistory: This team has assignment history, so it can’t be deleted.

positions.hasHistory: This position has assignment history, so it can’t be deleted.

palette.trigger: Search people or jump to a page
palette.label: Command menu
palette.empty: No matches. Try a different name or page.
palette.hint: Press Enter to open, Esc to close

settings.title: Church settings
settings.lead: Set up how {church} works in Ecclesia.

general.title: General
general.lead: Your church’s name, language, time zone and currency.
general.name: Church name
general.defaultLocaleHint: Used for new members until they choose their own.

members.title: Members and invitations
members.lead: Everyone who can sign in to {church}, and invitations waiting to be accepted.
members.inviteLead: Ecclesia creates a private link for them. It works once and expires after 14 days.
members.personHint: Link to their record in People so team-based access works.
members.linkLead: Send this link to {email}. It can be used once and expires on {date}.
members.whatsappMessage: You have been invited to join {church} on Ecclesia: {link}
members.removeLead: They will no longer be able to sign in to {church}. Their record in People stays.
members.revokeLead: The link stops working straight away.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.lead: Roles decide what each person can see and do. Built-in roles are fixed – create your own to fit how {church} works.
roles.members: {count, plural, =0 {No members} one {# member} other {# members}}
roles.readOnly: Built-in roles are fixed. Create a custom role to change permissions.

services.title: Service times
services.lead: The services ushers can open for a headcount.

categories.title: Attendance categories
categories.lead: The groups ushers count at every service. This order is the order on the headcount screen.
categories.hiddenNote: Hidden categories keep their history but are no longer counted.

invite.title: You’re invited to {church}
invite.lead: Join as {role}. Sign in or create an account with {email} to accept.
invite.wrongAccount: This invitation is for {email}, but you’re signed in as {current}. Sign out, then sign in with the invited email.
invite.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask your church administrator for a new one.
invite.revoked: This invitation was cancelled. Ask your church administrator if you still need access.
invite.used: This invitation has already been used.
invite.notFound: This invitation link isn’t valid. Check that you copied the whole link.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.lead: This page doesn’t exist, or you don’t have access to it.
